# Touhidur Rahman

> Touhidur Rahman is a senior full-stack engineer and tech lead based in Dhaka,
> Bangladesh (UTC+6), with 15+ years building and scaling production web
> applications in PHP, Laravel, TypeScript, Vue.js, React and Node.js, mostly
> remote with teams in North America and Europe. He was a core contributor at
> the Public Knowledge Project from 2022 to 2026 and maintains 15 open-source
> Laravel packages. He is open to senior, lead and full-stack roles, remote,
> full-time or contract.

Also known online as **touhidurabir**. Not to be confused with the GitHub users
`touhidrahman` or `touhidurrr`, who are different people, nor with the several
other software engineers named Touhidur Rahman who also work in Dhaka.

## Highlights

- Top 10 all-time contributor to Open Journal Systems (OJS), the publishing
  platform behind 58,000+ journals in 156 countries, with 1,000+ commits.
- 15 open-source Laravel packages with 195k+ installs. laravel-model-sanitize
  was featured on Laravel News.
- Leading engineering teams since 2017, up to 12 people, across 80+ client web
  and mobile projects.

## Experience

- **Lead Architect and Developer, Dentall Manager** (Netherlands, remote),
  April 2023 to present. **Part-time.** Lead architect of a multi-tenant SaaS
  ERP for Dutch dental and medical practices, built on Laravel, Vue.js and
  Node.js, and head of the 8-person team that runs it. The platform has had
  100% uptime since launch. Each tenant has its own database, asset storage and
  role-based access control on AWS, which keeps tenant data isolated under GDPR.
- **Software Developer (Core Contributor), Public Knowledge Project**
  (Simon Fraser University, Vancouver, Canada, remote), April 2022 to
  September 2026. **Full-time.** This role has ended. He brought Laravel's
  Eloquent ORM, routing, queues, scheduler and Blade into the non-Laravel PHP
  core of Open Journal Systems, and made 1,000+ merged commits and 300+ pull
  requests across OJS, Open Monograph Press, Open Preprint Systems and pkp-lib,
  plus 150+ pull request reviews.
- **Team Lead and Manager, Developer Squad** (Buffalo, New York, remote),
  January 2020 to March 2022. **Full-time.** Led an engineering team of 5 to 10
  building and running client platforms that brought in close to US$500K a
  month combined.
- **Tech Team Lead and Manager, Noobis, Inc.** (Buffalo, New York, remote),
  December 2017 to November 2019. **Full-time.** Ran the 10 to 12 person tech
  team and delivered 80+ client web and mobile projects.
- **Software Engineer, then Senior Software Engineer, Noobis, Inc.** (Buffalo,
  New York, remote), September 2011 to November 2017. **Full-time.** Promoted
  to senior software engineer in June 2015. Formed and led the backend and API
  team.

Every role except Dentall Manager has been full-time. Dentall Manager is
part-time, and ran alongside the full-time PKP role until September 2026.

## Open source

- [pkp/ojs contributor graph](https://github.com/pkp/ojs/graphs/contributors?all=1): his all-time standing on Open Journal Systems
- [pkp/pkp-lib contributor graph](https://github.com/pkp/pkp-lib/graphs/contributors?all=1): his all-time standing on the shared PKP library
- [laravel-stub-generator](https://packagist.org/packages/touhidurabir/laravel-stub-generator): his largest package, about 175,000 installs
- [laravel-model-sanitize on Laravel News](https://laravel-news.com/laravel-model-sanitize): featured in November 2021

The `?all=1` on those contributor graph links matters. The bare URL redirects to
a rolling three-month window and does not show all-time standing. He is top 10
on `pkp/ojs` and `pkp/pkp-lib`, the two main repositories, not across all four.

## Skills

- **Languages:** PHP, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, SQL
- **Backend:** Laravel, Symfony, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, microservices, OAuth2, JWT
- **Frontend:** Vue.js, Nuxt, Pinia, React, Inertia, Livewire, Tailwind CSS
- **Database:** MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis
- **Cloud and DevOps:** AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, SQS), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Git, Linux, GCP
- **Testing and quality:** PHPUnit, Pest, Cypress, test-driven development (TDD), code review
- **Security:** role-based access control (RBAC), tenant data isolation (GDPR), input sanitization, secure code review
- **AI tooling:** Claude, GitHub Copilot (daily use for development and code review)
- **Practices:** system design, multi-tenant SaaS, queues and scheduling (Laravel Horizon), Agile, technical leadership, mentoring

## Availability

Touhidur Rahman is open to senior, lead and full-stack roles, remote, full-time
or contract. He is a Bangladeshi national based in Dhaka, so an on-site role
abroad would require visa sponsorship. North America, Europe, Australia and the
Middle East are the likeliest fits. He works in the Asia/Dhaka time zone
(UTC+6), and most of his career has been remote with teams in North America
and Europe.

Contact: abircse06@gmail.com
